build_function_write_pid_file: write the current process PID and metadata to the gateway PID file
create_function_get_running_pid: get the PID of a running gateway instance from the PID file, verifying the process is alive
test_function_is_gateway_running: test whether the gateway daemon is currently running by checking the PID file
create_function_acquire_scoped_lock: acquire a machine-local lock keyed by scope and identity to prevent duplicate gateway identities
build_function_write_takeover_marker: record that a target PID is being replaced by the current process for --replace handoffs
test_function_read_runtime_status: read the persisted gateway runtime health and status information from the state file
create_function_terminate_pid: terminate a process PID with platform-appropriate force semantics using SIGTERM or SIGKILL
refactor_function_release_scoped_lock: release a previously-acquired scoped lock when owned by the current process
